statement: A traveler can browse the public TripIt marketing surfaces, register or sign in with a site-local account, organize trips across Upcoming/Past/Unfiled tabs, add and manage all twelve plan types inside a trip (anchored by adding the Hilton Midtown Manhattan hotel reservation May 23-26 to the existing seeded New York trip), import confirmation emails deterministically from a fixture library, share trips with role-scoped invitees, attach documents, export print and ICS views, and upgrade to TripIt Pro through test-mode payments with Pro features served by deterministic local adapters. Anonymous marketing and auth-shell surfaces replicate frozen source pixels; authenticated surfaces are honest local contracts pending authenticated source capture. Production TripIt services, credentials, and live payments are never touched.

actor_scope.notes: Browses the captured marketing, auth-shell, and legal surfaces; owns no state.

The login/create/forgot form shells and client-side validation are directly captured; server-side auth flows are benchmark-owned local contracts. No production credential is ever requested, stored, or replayed.
Verified site-local account resolved only from a server-side session digest; the resolved subject is the exact traveler business subject.

Owner of the seeded dataset (traveler@example.com). Authenticated source pixels are unavailable this round (Browserbase retired, Steel Live View handoff pending a user-driven session); functional semantics follow the frozen feature-floor contract and are upgradeable to direct evidence in a later capture round without re-freezing anonymous contracts.

traveler.free-local after a test-mode Pro activation; Pro features are deterministic fixture adapters. Pro source pixels pend the user-driven Steel Live View session.
Token-gated admin reset/lifecycle probes on isolated paths; not a product user or public route.
Delivers outbox rows on local profiles; never a production mail sender.

simulations: Site-local registration, verification, sign-in, opaque server sessions, password recovery, and mail outbox semantics are benchmark-owned synthetic behavior; they never request or imply production TripIt credentials, cookies, or email delivery.

Inbound email import is modeled as a deterministic site capability: a seeded fixture library plus an unlinked simulator inbox surface. Visible product surfaces (forward-to-plans copy, Unfiled routing, import history) follow the frozen contract; no production mailbox or SMTP ingestion exists.

External travel data (flight status, gates, weather, maps, airports, transit, safety, carbon, stats, guides, loyalty, fares, baggage) comes from deterministic local fixture adapters keyed by the frozen clock 2026-08-04T09:00:00-04:00.
TripIt Pro payments run only through the local sandbox or per-site Stripe test mode behind the shared edge verifier; live payment credentials are structurally forbidden.
out_of_scope: Production TripIt accounts, credentials, cookies, tokens, verification codes, and payment data (never requested, stored, or output)
Live Stripe keys, live charges, or any unauthorized source-site side effects
Real inbound SMTP ingestion at plans@tripit.com; only the deterministic fixture import capability is modeled
Google SSO federation (the button renders; the federated flow terminates in a local explanatory boundary, never contacting Google)
Native iOS/Android apps, app-store distribution, and deep links into native apps
Locale variants (en-uk, fr, de, es-co, es) beyond the frozen en-US baseline; the language menu renders with source-observed entries
External help center (help.tripit.com / freshdesk), concur.com, social platforms, jobs.sap.com, and blog article deep content beyond the captured blog index
TripIt 20th-anniversary campaign microsite and YouTube-embedded video playback (poster frame only)
Public redistribution approval for TripIt/Concur/SAP trademarks, imagery, and fonts (technically-verified never asserts redistribution rights)
Catalog-scale content beyond the frozen seed dataset (entity counts intentionally reduced; page families, fields, interactions, and states are not reduced)
